hero.title2: Proof that cannot be quietly changed.
hero.subtitle: Permissioned blockchain, smart contracts, dApps, tokenization and Layer-2 solutions for records that many parties need to trust.

challenge.title: The challenge in KSA
challenge.body: Supply chains, property transactions, certificates and energy markets involve many organizations that each keep their own records. Reconciling them is slow, and forged or altered documents are hard to detect.

opportunity.title: The opportunity
opportunity.body: A shared, permissioned ledger gives every authorized party the same tamper-evident record, and smart contracts automate the steps between them.

capabilities.title: Permissioned blockchain
capabilities.body: Enterprise networks built on Hyperledger Fabric, with governance for each participant.

capabilities.title: Smart contracts and audits
capabilities.body: Development and independent review of contract logic.

capabilities.title: Decentralized applications
capabilities.body: User-facing apps that read from and write to the ledger.

capabilities.title: Tokenization
capabilities.body: Digital representation of assets, rights and entitlements.

capabilities.title: Layer-2 solutions
capabilities.body: Higher throughput and lower cost for high-volume use cases.

applications.title: Supply-chain finance
applications.body: Shared visibility of invoices and shipments to speed up financing.

applications.title: Certificates and credentials
applications.body: Instantly verifiable academic and professional certificates.

applications.title: Energy trading
applications.body: Transparent settlement for energy generation and consumption.

applications.title: Health records
applications.body: Consent-based sharing of records between providers.

vision2030.body: Trusted digital records reduce friction in government services, finance and real estate, and support new digital business models.

deployment.note: Nodes hosted in-Kingdom, on participants' premises, or a mix of both.

seo.title: Blockchain & Trusted Digital Records | Saudi Arabia
seo.description: Permissioned blockchain, smart contracts and tokenization for supply-chain finance, real-estate records, certificates and energy trading in Saudi Arabia.
